body:
## Describe the bug

LongCat-2.0 (LongcatFlashForCausalLM) crashes in the RoPE of its **second attention** (`self_attn[1]`) during prefill **only when an EP MoE backend (DeepEP/UCCL) is actually active**:

```
File ".../models/longcat_flash.py", line 484, in forward_mlp
    attn_out = self.self_attn[1](...)
File ".../models/deepseek_common/attention_forward_methods/forward_mha.py", line 261, in forward_normal_prepare
    q_pe, k_pe = self.rotary_emb(positions, q_pe, k_pe)
File ".../layers/rotary_embedding/base.py", line 372, in forward_cuda
    q_rope = query.view(batch_size, -1, self.head_size)
RuntimeError: shape '[16, -1, 64]' is invalid for input of size 256
```

## Root cause

LongCat-Flash uses a ScMoE layer with **two attentions per layer** (`self_attn[0]` via `moe_layer_communicator`, `self_attn[1]` via `mlp_layer_communicator[1]`). Instrumenting the RoPE call in `forward_mha.py` right before `self.rotary_emb(...)`:

```
self_attn[0]: hidden=(16, 8192)  attn_mode=TP_ATTN_FULL  positions=(16,)  q_pe=(16,4,64)  -> OK
self_attn[1]: hidden=(1 , 8192)  attn_mode=TP_ATTN_FULL  positions=(16,)  q_pe=(1 ,4,64)  -> view(16,-1,64) on 256 elems -> crash
```

 receives hidden **still SCATTERED (1 token)** while  is full (16).  should have all-gathered hidden back to TP_ATTN_FULL but does not.

The reason it does not: in `longcat_flash.py` the `mlp_layer_scatter_modes` are built with `is_previous_layer_sparse=False` (there is even a `# TODO: Check if the following is correct.` next to it). But `self_attn[1]`'s input in the dataflow comes straight from the MoE branch: `forward` calls `moe_layer_communicator.prepare_mlp(...)` which returns **SCATTERED** hidden (under EP), and that scattered tensor is passed into `forward_mlp` -> `mlps[0]` -> `self_attn[1]`. So the previous layer for `mlp_layer_communicator[1]` is effectively **sparse**, and `_compute_layer_input_mode` mis-computes the gather.

## Why only with an EP backend

`communicator.py::_compute_mlp_mode` for a sparse layer returns `SCATTERED` iff `not get_moe_a2a_backend().is_none()` (i.e. deepep/uccl/... active), else `FULL`. With the default/StandardDispatcher path (`--moe-a2a-backend none`) the MoE branch stays `FULL`, hidden is never scattered, `self_attn[1]` gets full 16 tokens, and there is no crash. Only when a real EP backend is enabled does `prepare_mlp` scatter to 1 token and expose the bug.

## Reproduction

- Model: meituan-longcat/LongCat-2.0-FP8
- 4x H200, tp16/ep16, PD-disaggregation prefill, `--moe-a2a-backend deepep --deepep-mode normal`
- (also need `moe_topk` recognized so the EP backend actually initializes; see separate PR #30975)

## Reference: NPU implementation

The official NPU port (meituan-longcat/SGLang-FluentLLM, `npu` branch, `npu_longcat_flash.py::forward_prefill`) always runs both `self_attn[i]` on full-token hidden by gathering inside attention (`gather_qkv=True`) with `reduce_scatter` on the MLP side. The CUDA path lacks the in-attention gather and relies on the LayerCommunicator to gather before `self_attn[1]`, which it currently doesn't.

## Environment

sglang nightly-dev-cu13-20260708 through 20260713 (latest); bug present in all, no fix in `longcat_flash.py` / `forward_mha.py` between these.
title: [Bug] LongCat-2.0 second attention RoPE crash under EP MoE backend (hidden stays scattered while positions is full)
